summary.en: A fire aboard the orbital station: isolate, protect, suppress with CO2, then restore the atmosphere.
summary.ar: A fire aboard the orbital station: isolate, protect, suppress with CO2, then restore the atmosphere.

briefing.en: Without buoyancy there is no upward plume: flames grow as slow spheres and can survive on less oxygen.
briefing.ar: Without buoyancy there is no upward plume: flames grow as slow spheres and can survive on less oxygen.

briefing.en: CO2 puts the fire out but also displaces breathable oxygen. Watch the cabin gauge.
briefing.ar: CO2 puts the fire out but also displaces breathable oxygen. Watch the cabin gauge.

briefing.en: Ventilation off during suppression, scrubber on afterwards.
briefing.ar: Ventilation off during suppression, scrubber on afterwards.

hint.en: Follow the alarm to the science rack.
hint.ar: Follow the alarm to the science rack.

hint.en: Control panel: cut rack power and stop ventilation to starve the flow.
hint.ar: Control panel: cut rack power and stop ventilation to starve the flow.

hint.en: Emergency locker: CO2 extinguisher, thermal gloves, fire blanket.
hint.ar: Emergency locker: CO2 extinguisher, thermal gloves, fire blanket.

hint.en: You cannot discharge CO2 bare-handed in freefall.
hint.ar: You cannot discharge CO2 bare-handed in freefall.

hint.en: Discharge CO2 in short bursts until the flame is out and the cabin is safe.
hint.ar: Discharge CO2 in short bursts until the flame is out and the cabin is safe.

hint.en: Run the fire simulation until the fire is out.
hint.ar: Run the fire simulation until the fire is out.

hint.en: Restart airflow and the CO2 scrubber to clear combustion products.
hint.ar: Restart airflow and the CO2 scrubber to clear combustion products.

hint.en: Scan O2, CO2, smoke and temperature, then reset the alarm.
hint.ar: Scan O2, CO2, smoke and temperature, then reset the alarm.

message.en: The CO2 horn frosts instantly – you need thermal gloves.
message.ar: The CO2 horn frosts instantly – you need thermal gloves.

message.en: Restarting airflow feeds the fire with oxygen. Suppress it first.
message.ar: Restarting airflow feeds the fire with oxygen. Suppress it first.

summary.en: Fire suppressed and the cabin certified safe.
summary.ar: Fire suppressed and the cabin certified safe.

reason.en: Careful CO2 use kept the cabin breathable.
reason.ar: Careful CO2 use kept the cabin breathable.

detail.en: In microgravity, hot gas does not rise, so flames become spherical, burn cooler and can persist at lower oxygen levels; NASA's FLEX experiments even observed 'cool flames' continuing after the visible flame went out.
detail.ar: In microgravity, hot gas does not rise, so flames become spherical, burn cooler and can persist at lower oxygen levels; NASA's FLEX experiments even observed 'cool flames' continuing after the visible flame went out.

detail.en: The ISS uses CO2 extinguishers because water or powder would float freely and damage equipment; CO2 displaces oxygen locally, which is itself a crew hazard.
detail.ar: The ISS uses CO2 extinguishers because water or powder would float freely and damage equipment; CO2 displaces oxygen locally, which is itself a crew hazard.

disclaimer: Educational game simulation. Fire and atmosphere physics are simplified for gameplay.
